visual_logic.color_palette: Pale sand and terracotta; the long neck has soft horizontal white stripes.
visual_logic.environment: Arid coastal dunes; the wind is kicking up a soft, non-obscuring 'sand-mist' around the feet.

pose: Neck fully extended upward, looking like a living skyscraper; the pose emphasizes the sheer elegance and height of the animal.
